GrokImagineVideoV15ImageToVideoInput.description:
``grok-imagine-video-1.5`` image-to-video (no ``aspect_ratio``).

Widens ``resolution`` to add the 1080p tier supported by the 1.5 model
(the standard model remains 480p/720p only).

image_url.description: URL of the input image for video generation.
image_url.title: Image URL

prompt.description: Text description of desired changes or motion in the video.
examples: Medieval knight in ornate armor walking through a mystical forest, bioluminescent plants pulsing with light, ancient stone ruins overgrown with glowing vines, over-the-shoulder camera, dark fantasy aesthetic, volumetric fog and Lumen lighting
prompt.title: Prompt
